title: Public Alert No. 09/2024 – Sale of Unregistered ZACEF-TZ Injection in Nigeria
text: NAFDAC warned Nigerians about an unregistered Ceftriaxone and Tazobactam injection discovered in Nigeria and advised healthcare providers to avoid falsified medicines.

title: NAFDAC exposes new counterfeit drugs circulating in Nigeria
text: NAFDAC alerted the public about counterfeit Artemether/Lumefantrine tablets marketed as Aflotin 20/120 and advised medicine sellers and consumers to verify products.

title: NAFDAC introduces new technology to combat counterfeit medical products
text: NAFDAC promoted digital tools including GreenBook and traceability systems to help identify and prevent fake medicines entering the supply chain.

title: NAFDAC alerts Nigerians on fake cancer treatment drugs
text: NAFDAC warned healthcare workers and patients about counterfeit Phesgo cancer treatment products discovered in Nigeria.

title: NAFDAC alerts public on counterfeit chlorpheniramine, dexamethasone injection
text: NAFDAC reported mislabelled injections circulating in Nigeria and advised people to purchase medicines only from authorised suppliers.

title: NAFDAC destroys fake drugs worth N100trn
text: NAFDAC destroyed seized fake, substandard and falsified medicines recovered during enforcement operations in southeastern Nigeria.

title: Fake Drugs: NAFDAC takes over Ariaria drug market in Aba
text: NAFDAC carried out enforcement activities at Ariaria International Market after discovering large quantities of unregistered and banned medicines.

title: NAFDAC warns against circulation of falsified Postinor-2 contraceptives
text: NAFDAC alerted Nigerians about falsified Postinor-2 contraceptive products and provided guidance for identifying suspicious batches.

title: NAFDAC warns of counterfeit Avastin cancer drug circulating in Nigeria
text: NAFDAC investigated counterfeit Avastin cancer medicine and warned that fake oncology medicines create serious patient safety risks.

title: NAFDAC recalls multiple substandard and falsified medicines through public alerts
text: NAFDAC published multiple safety alerts covering recalled medicines, counterfeit products and substandard pharmaceutical batches.

title: Public Alert No. 049/2024 – Confirmed Counterfeit Paludex Artemether/Lumefantrine Tablets and Suspension
text: NAFDAC alerted Nigerians about counterfeit Paludex antimalarial products discovered through surveillance activities and advised against use of unverified medicines.

title: NAFDAC warns Nigerians of fake anti-malaria drugs in circulation
text: NAFDAC warned about counterfeit Combiart Dispersible Tablets found during surveillance in Nigeria, with laboratory testing showing absence of active pharmaceutical ingredients.

title: Public Alert No. 043/2024 – Counterfeit COMBIART Dispersible Tablet in Nigeria
text: NAFDAC issued an alert on counterfeit Combiart antimalarial tablets circulating in Nigeria and urged consumers to obtain medicines from approved sources.

title: Public Alert No. 030/2024 – Confirmed Counterfeit Avastin in Nigeria
text: NAFDAC warned healthcare professionals and patients about counterfeit Avastin injection products identified in Nigeria.

title: Public Alert No. 025/2024 – Counterfeit PHESGO Injection in Nigeria
text: NAFDAC alerted the public about counterfeit PHESGO injection discovered in Nigeria and advised healthcare providers to verify oncology medicines before use.

title: Public Alert No. 021/2024 – Confirmed Falsified Lins Meropenem Injection Used in Abuja
text: NAFDAC reported falsified Meropenem injection discovered in Nigeria and warned against purchasing medicines from unregulated sources.

title: Public Alert No. 020/2024 – Falsified OHEAL Ampicillin and Cloxacillin Capsule
text: NAFDAC issued a warning about falsified antibiotic capsules and advised distributors and healthcare providers to remain vigilant.

title: Public Alert No. 016/2024 – Substandard Asian Ampicillin/Cloxacillin Suspension
text: NAFDAC alerted Nigerians about substandard antibiotic suspension products and requested reporting of suspected falsified medicines.

title: Public Alert No. 010/2024 – Falsified Mislabelled Paracetamol Injection
text: NAFDAC warned about falsified Paracetamol injection circulating in Nigeria and highlighted the risks associated with unverified pharmaceutical products.

title: NAFDAC analyses N1.7bn fake drugs seized by Customs
text: NAFDAC analysed seized pharmaceutical products including Augmentin, Ampiclox and Amoxicillin capsules after Customs intercepted suspected fake drugs.

title: NAFDAC launches GreenBook to improve access to registered medicines
text: NAFDAC introduced the GreenBook digital platform to help Nigerians and healthcare professionals verify approved medicines registered in Nigeria.

title: NAFDAC strengthens pharmacovigilance system for medicine safety monitoring
text: NAFDAC highlighted the importance of pharmacovigilance activities in detecting adverse drug reactions and improving medicine safety.

title: NAFDAC advises Nigerians to report adverse drug reactions
text: NAFDAC encouraged consumers and healthcare workers to report suspected medicine side effects through official pharmacovigilance channels.

title: Nigeria launches antimicrobial resistance action initiatives
text: Nigeria continued efforts to address antimicrobial resistance through awareness campaigns, surveillance and responsible antibiotic use programmes.

title: NAFDAC warns against irrational use of antibiotics
text: NAFDAC advised Nigerians against misuse of antibiotics, noting that inappropriate use contributes to antimicrobial resistance.

title: NAFDAC conducts enforcement operations against illegal drug markets
text: NAFDAC enforcement activities targeted illegal medicine markets and unregistered pharmaceutical distributors to improve drug quality control.

title: NAFDAC advises consumers to buy medicines from licensed outlets
text: NAFDAC reminded Nigerians that purchasing medicines from approved pharmacies helps reduce exposure to counterfeit and substandard products.

title: Nigeria improves pharmaceutical traceability and supply chain monitoring
text: Health authorities promoted stronger medicine supply chain systems to improve availability and reduce circulation of poor-quality medicines.

title: NAFDAC increases surveillance of imported pharmaceutical products
text: NAFDAC reported continued surveillance of imported medicines entering Nigeria to prevent unsafe pharmaceutical products from reaching consumers.

title: NAFDAC promotes public awareness on counterfeit medicine dangers
text: NAFDAC used public education campaigns to improve awareness about the risks of counterfeit and falsified medicines.
